answer: Each identity must hold two unshareable credentials: a cedar work credential for task history and a haven standing credential for payment standing, 25 units each. Each epoch both must co-sign a gale check, a nonce signed within the same minute. The kth fake needs two fresh credentials and another live session, so its marginal cost is 50 plus 25(k-1) units; 1000 fakes cost 12,537,500 units. An honest agent pays 50 once for one pair. A rental ring fails: a rented credential cannot co-sign the fresh nonce without its private key, and double-signing credentials are revoked.
